description: Employment contracts covering full-time, part-time, and executive employment relationships

required_clauses.description: Defines salary, bonus, equity, benefits, and payment schedule
Assigns all work product and inventions created during employment to the employer
Prohibits disclosure of trade secrets and confidential business information during and after employment
Defines termination triggers, notice periods, severance, and at-will provisions
Restricts employee from working for competitors during and after employment — enforceability varies by state
Restricts employee from soliciting company clients, customers, or employees after departure
Defines job title, reporting structure, and scope of responsibilities
Defines how disputes are resolved — arbitration, mediation, or litigation
Specifies which state law governs the employment relationship
States this agreement supersedes all prior offers, negotiations, and understandings

optional_clauses.description: Defines severance pay upon termination without cause
Defines stock option or RSU vesting schedule
Defines remote work rights and expectations
